# iGaming News Today

> The independent news authority for the global iGaming, sports betting, online casino, and regulatory sectors.

## Overview
iGaming News Today delivers verified, primary-source coverage of industry developments, legal and regulatory updates, M&A, partnerships, and market intelligence across global regulated jurisdictions.

## Main Sections
- [News](https://igamingnewstoday.co/category/news/): Breaking stories and primary source reporting across worldwide gaming markets.
- [Casino](https://igamingnewstoday.co/category/casino/): Updates on online casinos, slot releases, game studios, and provider partnerships.
- [Sports Betting](https://igamingnewstoday.co/category/sports-betting/): Legal sports betting coverage, state and national market dynamics, and operator performance.
- [Regulation & Legal](https://igamingnewstoday.co/category/regulation/): Compliance, licensing, legislative moves, and responsible gambling developments.
- [Business & M&A](https://igamingnewstoday.co/category/business/): Mergers, acquisitions, earnings, financing, and C-level executive moves.
- [Events](https://igamingnewstoday.co/events/): Global iGaming industry conferences, exhibitions, and expos.
- [Directory](https://igamingnewstoday.co/directory/): Directory of licensed operators, suppliers, affiliates, and technology providers.
- [FAQ](https://igamingnewstoday.co/frequently-asked-questions/): Editorial policy, publishing schedule, and company information.

## Policies & Compliance
- [Editorial Guidelines](https://igamingnewstoday.co/privacy-policy/): Fact-checking, corrections, and editorial independence.
- [Responsible Gambling](https://igamingnewstoday.co/responsible-gambling/): Support resources, player protection, and 18+ compliance.
- [Contact & Tips](https://igamingnewstoday.co/contact-us/): Direct editorial and newsroom contact.
